description:
Send the user's feedback to the Smartpress team: a problem they ran into, a suggestion, or praise.

Rules:
- Call this ONLY when the user asks to send feedback, report a problem, or pass on praise. Never call it on your own after an error; you may offer it.
- Before calling, show the user what you'll send (type, and the message) and get their yes.
- Put the user's own words in "message". Leave out payment details, passwords and anything they asked you not to share.
- Pass the ids of what the conversation was working on (product, configuration, artwork, proof), and for a failed tool call its name and error, so the team can find it.

Afterwards, give the user the reference (e.g. FB-3F9K). Nobody replies through this channel; for help with an order, point them to Smartpress customer support.

contactEmail.description: Only when the user offers an email address for a reply.

errorMessage.description: For a problem with a failed tool call: the error it returned.

fileSessionId.description: The uploaded artwork being discussed, when there is one.

message.description: The user's feedback in their own words. Quote or closely follow what they said; don't summarize it into your words.

productConfigSessionId.description: The configuration being discussed, when there is one.

productId.description: The product being discussed, e.g. "SLS_12", when there is one.

proofId.description: The proof being discussed, when there is one.

relatedTool.description: For a problem with a failed tool call: that tool's name.

severity.description: Problems only, required for a problem: "blocked" = it stopped the user from ordering, "workaround" = they got around it, "cosmetic" = minor. Leave out for a suggestion or praise.

type.description: "problem" for something that went wrong, "suggestion" for an idea, "praise" for something that worked well.

name: send_feedback
title: Send feedback to Smartpress
